args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed production health checks following its deploy. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0. Post-rollback service is healthy with error rate 0.2%. v2.3.1 is blocked pending investigation; v2.3.1-rc had already been unhealthy in staging.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: The deploy history showed v2.3.1 (production) was unhealthy — the cause of the failing health checks. The most recent *healthy* production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.0 and v2.2.9 were both healthy; note v2.3.1-rc had also been unhealthy in staging).
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
3. **Verified recovery**: the service now reports healthy in all regions, running v2.3.0, with an error rate of 0.2%.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (keyed `checkout-api-rollback-v2.3.1`) describing the failing deploy, the rollback action, and the recovered state — the on-call engineer has been paged.
